key.name: srt-url
key.description: The URL of the LinTO Studio endpoint the local audio stream is sent to. This is the currently selected address, taken from the saved address list. SRT, for example srt://studio.linto.ai:8889?streamid=SESSION_ID,0&mode=caller and RTMP, for example rtmp://studio.linto.ai:1935/SESSION_ID/0 are supported.

key.name: addresses
key.description: The saved stream addresses, each a (label, URL) pair. The user picks which one is active; its URL is mirrored to srt-url.

key.name: control-enabled
key.description: Whether the embedded control server (for Stream Controller) is running.

key.name: control-password
key.description: The password a Stream Controller client must supply. Generated on first use; regenerated only when the user asks for a new one.

key.name: debug-enabled
key.description: Whether verbose diagnostic logging to a file is enabled. Off by default; used to track down streaming problems.

key.name: control-port
key.description: The TCP port the control server listens on.

key.name: srt-latency
key.description: The SRT send latency in milliseconds. A larger value gives SRT more time to retransmit lost packets before the receiver drops them, at the cost of extra delay. Ignored when the streaming URL already sets a latency parameter, and not used for RTMP.
